ipos.name: Grace Cancer Foundation - ZCZP
ipos.about: Grace Cancer Foundation (GRACE – Global Research and Cancer Education) is a Hyderabad-based public charitable trust established on October 26, 2013, by medical professionals to alleviate the burden of cancer through accessible preventive healthcare. Operating primarily across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Karnataka, alongside global partnerships, the Foundation anchors its operations on 4 core pillars: cancer prevention through community health awareness, early detection via mobile screening bus units and rural medical camps, treatment support and patient navigation for economically disadvantaged communities, and technological research including AI-driven screening tools. The Trust holds valid regulatory registrations under Sections 12AB and 80G of the Income Tax Act, 1961, and is registered under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA), 2010.
